gloss: to pull in hand over hand; to trace back

definitions.gloss: to pull in hand over hand; to haul in; to reel in
definitions.explanation: To draw in something long and flexible — a rope, thread, net, or line — by moving the hands alternately along it.

definitions.gloss: to trace back; to follow (a memory, a lead)
definitions.explanation: To follow a memory, a chain of associations, or a thread of evidence back toward its source, as if pulling it in bit by bit.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive; the thing being drawn in takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. There is no intransitive partner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手繰|たぐ}る: to pull in a thread
- ⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手繰|たぐ}る: to haul in a net
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手繰|たぐ}る: to search back through one's memory
- {手繰|たぐ}り{寄|よ}せる: to draw in toward oneself (the most common form of all)

USAGE:
Sense 2 is the one learners meet most often, usually as ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手繰|たぐ}り{寄|よ}せる in narration. It keeps the image of sense 1 alive: the memory is a line you pull in a little at a time until the far end comes into view.
